name: Model Validator & Promoter
description: Validates a newly fine-tuned model before promoting it to serve live traffic. Runs the new model against the held-out test set from the training data store. Computes evaluation scores using the same evaluators as the confidence engine. Promotion criteria: new model must score above a configurable threshold (default: phase2_to_phase3 threshold) on the test set. If validation passes: signals the Local Model Server to swap to the new model version. If validation fails: logs warning, keeps current model, discards the candidate. Records validation results and promotion decisions in the audit log. Designed with clear separation between validation (pure evaluation) and promotion (side-effectful swap) to enable testing, auditing, and manual review workflows.

types.name: PromotionDecision
types.description: StrEnum representing the outcome of a model validation and promotion attempt. Provides full auditability of why a candidate was or was not promoted.

fields.name: metric_name
fields.description: Name of the evaluation metric (must match a key in ValidationResult.per_metric_scores).

fields.name: min_score
fields.description: Minimum acceptable score for this metric.

validators.error_message: Per-metric threshold min_score must be in [0.0, 1.0].

types.description: A threshold constraint for an individual evaluation metric. If specified, the candidate must also pass each per-metric threshold in addition to the aggregate threshold.

types.name: ValidationConfig

fields.name: promotion_threshold
fields.description: Aggregate score threshold the candidate must meet or exceed (depending on threshold_comparison) to be promoted. Defaults to the phase2_to_phase3 confidence threshold.

fields.name: min_test_samples
fields.description: Minimum number of held-out test samples required to run validation. If the test set has fewer samples, validation is skipped with SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA.

fields.name: threshold_comparison
fields.description: Comparison operator used when checking aggregate score against promotion_threshold. 'gte' means score >= threshold; 'gt' means score > threshold.

fields.name: per_metric_thresholds
fields.description: Optional list of per-metric threshold constraints. If provided, each listed metric must independently pass its threshold in addition to the aggregate threshold.

fields.name: swap_timeout_seconds
fields.description: Maximum time in seconds to wait for the model server to complete the model swap operation.

types.description: Pydantic configuration model controlling validation and promotion behavior. Parsed strictly at startup; invalid config causes immediate failure with a clear error message.

types.name: PerMetricThresholdList

fields.name: reference
fields.description: Immutable reference metadata for this test set.

fields.name: samples
fields.description: The list of test samples.

fields.name: metric_name
fields.description: Name of the evaluation metric.

types.name: ValidationResult

fields.name: candidate_model_id
fields.description: Unique identifier of the candidate fine-tuned model being validated.

fields.name: timestamp_utc
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the validation was performed.

validators.error_message: timestamp_utc must be in ISO 8601 format.

fields.name: per_metric_scores
fields.description: Mapping of metric name to average score across all test samples for that metric. Keys are str, values are float in [0.0, 1.0].

fields.name: aggregate_score
fields.description: Weighted or unweighted mean of all per-metric scores. This is the primary score compared against the promotion threshold.

fields.name: threshold_used
fields.description: The promotion threshold that was applied for this validation decision.

fields.name: threshold_comparison_used
fields.description: The comparison operator that was applied (gte or gt).

fields.name: test_set_reference
fields.description: Reference to the exact test set used, including content hash for reproducibility.

fields.name: decision
fields.description: The outcome of the validation evaluation (does not include swap result — that is in PromotionRecord).

fields.name: failed_per_metric_thresholds
fields.description: List of metric names that failed their per-metric threshold checks (empty if all passed or no per-metric thresholds configured).

fields.name: evaluation_error_detail
fields.description: If decision is REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR, contains a human-readable description of what went wrong during evaluation. Empty string otherwise.

fields.name: samples_evaluated
fields.description: Number of test samples that were successfully evaluated.

types.description: Frozen (immutable) Pydantic model capturing the complete result of a candidate model validation. Contains all information needed for audit trail and promotion decision. This is the pure evaluation output — no side effects have occurred at this point.

types.name: FailedMetricList
types.description: List of metric names that failed per-metric threshold checks.

types.name: PromotionRecord

fields.name: validation_result
fields.description: The immutable validation result that informed the promotion decision.

fields.name: promotion_attempted
fields.description: Whether a model swap was attempted (true only if validation passed).

fields.name: swap_started_utc
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the model swap was initiated. Empty string if no swap was attempted.

fields.name: swap_completed_utc
fields.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of when the model swap completed (successfully or with error). Empty string if no swap was attempted.

fields.name: swap_duration_seconds
fields.description: Time in seconds the swap operation took. 0.0 if no swap was attempted.

fields.name: final_decision
fields.description: The final promotion decision, which may differ from the validation decision if the swap failed (e.g., validation said PROMOTED but swap_failed overrides to SWAP_FAILED).

fields.name: swap_error_detail
fields.description: If final_decision is SWAP_FAILED, contains a human-readable description of the swap error. Empty string otherwise.

fields.name: previous_model_id
fields.description: The model ID that was serving before this promotion attempt. Empty string if unknown or no swap was attempted.

types.description: Extends ValidationResult with promotion execution details. This is the complete audit record of a validation-and-promotion attempt, including any swap timing and errors.

functions.name: validate_candidate
functions.description: Runs the candidate fine-tuned model against the held-out test set from the training data store, computes evaluation scores using the injected evaluators (same as confidence engine), and returns an immutable ValidationResult. This is a pure evaluation method — it performs no side effects on the serving model. The candidate model must already be loadable/accessible by the model server for inference. The test set is fetched from the TrainingDataStore. All evaluation errors are caught internally and result in REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR decision rather than raising exceptions.

inputs.name: candidate_model_id
inputs.description: Unique identifier of the candidate fine-tuned model to validate.

inputs.name: test_set_id
inputs.description: Identifier of the held-out test set in the training data store to use for evaluation. If empty, the store's default held-out set for this model's domain is used.

error_cases.name: test_set_not_found
error_cases.condition: The specified test_set_id does not exist in the TrainingDataStore.

error_data.detail: Returns a ValidationResult with decision=SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA and zero scores rather than raising an exception.

error_cases.name: test_set_below_minimum
error_cases.condition: The test set exists but has fewer samples than ValidationConfig.min_test_samples.

error_data.detail: Returns a ValidationResult with decision=SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA. evaluation_error_detail describes the sample count shortfall.

error_cases.name: all_evaluators_failed
error_cases.condition: Every evaluator raises an exception or returns invalid results for all test samples.

error_data.detail: Returns a ValidationResult with decision=REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR, aggregate_score=0.0, and evaluation_error_detail describing the failures.

error_cases.name: candidate_model_inference_error
error_cases.condition: The candidate model cannot be loaded or fails to produce outputs for the test samples via the model server.

error_data.detail: Returns a ValidationResult with decision=REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR and evaluation_error_detail describing the inference failure.

error_cases.name: training_data_store_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The TrainingDataStore is unreachable or returns an error when fetching the test set.

error_data.detail: Returns a ValidationResult with decision=SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA and evaluation_error_detail describing the store access failure.

preconditions: The ModelValidator has been initialized with valid ValidationConfig, at least one Evaluator, a TrainingDataStore, a ModelServer, and an AuditLogger.
candidate_model_id refers to a model that the model server can load for inference (not necessarily currently serving).
postconditions: Returns an immutable ValidationResult with all fields populated.
ValidationResult.decision is one of: PROMOTED (passes threshold), REJECTED_BELOW_THRESHOLD, REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR, or SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA.
ValidationResult.decision is never SWAP_FAILED (swaps are not performed by this method).
ValidationResult.per_metric_scores contains one entry per evaluator that completed successfully.
ValidationResult.aggregate_score is the mean of per_metric_scores values, or 0.0 if no metrics completed.
ValidationResult.test_set_reference accurately reflects the test set that was used.
ValidationResult.timestamp_utc is set to the current UTC time at the start of validation.
No mutation to the currently serving model occurs.
The validation result is logged to the audit logger before returning.

structured_side_effects.description: Logs the complete ValidationResult as a structured JSON audit entry.
Sends inference requests to the candidate model via the model server to generate outputs for test samples.
Fetches the held-out test set from the training data store.

functions.name: promote_candidate
functions.description: Attempts to promote a validated candidate model to serve live traffic by instructing the local model server to swap to the new model version. This is the side-effectful counterpart to validate_candidate. Only proceeds with the swap if the ValidationResult indicates the candidate passed validation (decision == PROMOTED). If the ValidationResult decision is anything other than PROMOTED, no swap is attempted and a PromotionRecord is returned reflecting the original decision. Swap errors are caught and recorded — the method never raises exceptions past the public boundary.

inputs.name: validation_result
inputs.description: The immutable validation result from a prior call to validate_candidate. Must not be modified between validation and promotion.

error_cases.name: swap_timeout
error_cases.condition: The model server does not complete the swap within ValidationConfig.swap_timeout_seconds.

error_data.detail: Returns PromotionRecord with final_decision=SWAP_FAILED, swap_error_detail describes the timeout. Previous model continues serving.

error_cases.name: swap_connection_error
error_cases.condition: The model server is unreachable when attempting the swap.

error_data.detail: Returns PromotionRecord with final_decision=SWAP_FAILED, swap_error_detail describes the connection failure.

error_cases.name: swap_model_load_error
error_cases.condition: The model server accepts the swap request but fails to load the candidate model (e.g., corrupt weights, incompatible format).

error_data.detail: Returns PromotionRecord with final_decision=SWAP_FAILED, swap_error_detail includes the server's error response. Previous model is restored.

error_cases.name: model_server_not_ready
error_cases.condition: The model server reports it is not in a state that allows swaps (e.g., currently serving a batch, another swap in progress).

error_data.detail: Returns PromotionRecord with final_decision=SWAP_FAILED, swap_error_detail describes the server's not-ready state.

error_cases.name: validation_not_passed
error_cases.condition: validation_result.decision is not PROMOTED (e.g., REJECTED_BELOW_THRESHOLD, REJECTED_EVALUATION_ERROR, SKIPPED_NO_TEST_DATA).

error_data.detail: Returns PromotionRecord with promotion_attempted=false and final_decision matching the validation decision. No swap is attempted.

preconditions: The ModelValidator has been initialized with a valid ModelServer and AuditLogger.
validation_result is a complete, unmodified ValidationResult from a prior validate_candidate call.
validation_result.candidate_model_id still refers to an accessible model.
postconditions: Returns a PromotionRecord with all fields populated.
If validation_result.decision != PROMOTED: promotion_attempted is false, final_decision matches validation_result.decision, no swap is attempted.
If validation_result.decision == PROMOTED and swap succeeds: final_decision is PROMOTED, promotion_attempted is true, swap timing fields are populated.
If validation_result.decision == PROMOTED and swap fails: final_decision is SWAP_FAILED, promotion_attempted is true, swap_error_detail is populated, the previous model continues serving.
The PromotionRecord is logged to the audit logger before returning.
If swap fails, the model server continues serving the previous model version — no partial state.

structured_side_effects.description: If validation passed: instructs the local model server to swap from the current model to the candidate model version.
Logs the complete PromotionRecord as a structured JSON audit entry, including swap timing and any errors.

functions.name: validate_and_promote
functions.description: Convenience method that runs validate_candidate followed by promote_candidate in sequence. Equivalent to calling validate_candidate then passing the result to promote_candidate. Provides a single-call workflow for automated pipelines where manual review between validation and promotion is not needed.

inputs.name: candidate_model_id
inputs.description: Unique identifier of the candidate fine-tuned model to validate and potentially promote.

inputs.name: test_set_id
inputs.description: Identifier of the held-out test set. If empty, the store's default held-out set is used.

error_cases.name: validation_phase_error
error_cases.condition: Any error that would occur during validate_candidate (test set not found, evaluator failures, etc.).

error_data.detail: The error is captured in the ValidationResult within the PromotionRecord. promotion_attempted is false. See validate_candidate error cases.

error_cases.name: promotion_phase_error
error_cases.condition: Validation passes but the swap fails for any reason.

error_data.detail: The swap error is captured in the PromotionRecord. See promote_candidate error cases.

preconditions: The ModelValidator has been fully initialized with all dependencies.
candidate_model_id refers to an accessible model.
postconditions: Returns a PromotionRecord with a populated validation_result field.
All postconditions of validate_candidate and promote_candidate apply.
Both the ValidationResult and the PromotionRecord are logged to the audit logger.

structured_side_effects.description: Sends inference requests during validation and swap requests during promotion.
If validation passes: instructs model swap.

functions.name: get_validation_history
functions.description: Retrieves the history of validation results for a given model ID or all models. Reads from the audit log to reconstruct past validation and promotion records. Useful for monitoring trends, debugging, and compliance auditing.

inputs.name: candidate_model_id
inputs.description: Filter by candidate model ID. If empty, returns history for all models.

inputs.name: limit
inputs.description: Maximum number of records to return, most recent first.

error_cases.name: audit_log_unavailable
error_cases.condition: The audit logger's backing store is unreachable or corrupted.

error_data.detail: Returns an empty list and logs a warning. Does not raise an exception.

preconditions: The ModelValidator has been initialized with a valid AuditLogger.
postconditions: Returns a list of PromotionRecords ordered by timestamp descending (most recent first).
If candidate_model_id is provided, only records matching that model ID are returned.
The list contains at most 'limit' entries.
If no history exists, returns an empty list.

structured_side_effects.description: Reads historical validation and promotion records from the audit log's backing store.

confidence_engine: Provides Evaluator protocol instances that compute scores for model outputs against reference outputs.
Each Evaluator has an async evaluate(output: str, reference: str) -> EvaluationScore method.
Evaluators are stateless and safe to share across components.
The same evaluator instances used for live confidence scoring are injected into the validator for consistency.
local_model_server: Provides a ModelServer protocol with async methods: get_status() -> ModelServerStatus, swap_model(model_id: str) -> SwapResult, generate(model_id: str, prompt: str) -> str.
swap_model is atomic — either the new model is fully loaded and serving, or the previous model is restored.
generate can target a specific model_id for inference without changing the serving model.
The model server respects the swap_timeout_seconds configuration for swap operations.
training_data_store: Provides a TrainingDataStore protocol with async method: get_test_set(test_set_id: str) -> TestSet.
If test_set_id is empty, returns the default held-out test set.
The returned TestSet includes a TestSetReference with a content_hash for traceability.
Raises an identifiable error if the test set does not exist.
audit_logger: Provides an AuditLogger protocol with async methods: log_validation(result: ValidationResult) -> None, log_promotion(record: PromotionRecord) -> None, query_history(model_id: str, limit: int) -> list[PromotionRecord].
All log methods are non-blocking and must not raise exceptions that propagate to the caller.
Logged entries are persisted as structured JSON for machine-readable audit trails.
query_history returns records ordered by timestamp descending.

invariants: No exceptions are raised past the public interface boundary — all error conditions are represented in the return type (ValidationResult or PromotionRecord).
validate_candidate never mutates the currently serving model on the model server.
promote_candidate only attempts a swap if the provided ValidationResult.decision == PROMOTED.
If a model swap fails, the previous model continues serving — no partial state is possible.
All validation results and promotion decisions are logged to the audit logger before being returned to the caller.
The same evaluator implementations used by the confidence engine are used for validation, ensuring score consistency.
ValidationResult is immutable (frozen Pydantic model) — it cannot be modified after creation.
ValidationConfig is validated at initialization time — invalid config causes immediate failure, never silent defaults.
per_metric_scores keys always correspond to the metric names of the injected evaluators that completed successfully.
aggregate_score is always the arithmetic mean of per_metric_scores values, or 0.0 if per_metric_scores is empty.
All timestamps are UTC in ISO 8601 format.
No global state — all state flows through constructor-injected dependencies or explicit parameters.
